integrity: The qualitative zero-weight discontinuity was previously exhibited in 2019; the claimed new result is a simultaneous full cluster-set classification and exact norm diameters. Finite numerical and rational tests corroborate but do not substitute for the full proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform scalar integer-grid data with eventually constant secants, the original Akima midpoint fallback, and \(C^1_{\mathrm{loc}}\) cluster topology. The 1969 predecessor report is known only to year precision, and the full original 1970 article was not available. No claim for arbitrary nonuniform grids, modified Akima, or global convergence of arbitrary perturbations.
title: Exact cluster geometry of the original Akima interpolant at slope-degenerate data
